notes: v489 — fixes two things in the 📉 dip helper on the Practice buy screen. It was printing "median dip 0.00%" and "0.5% is its median dip" on the same screen; 0.5% is a floor we apply when a share has no typical dip, not the measurement, and it now says which it is. And on very low-priced shares it said no dip was reachable when one was: on a 0.6c share every small depth rounds back to the close, but the next real price down still exists. It now offers that price, tells you what dip it actually is, and how often the share has ever gone that far. Hard-refresh (Ctrl+F5) to update.
